B.C Tracker 2.0.0, now as an Android app.

New:
- Stage alerts. A notification as you reach each stage of your fast (digestion done, fat burning, ketosis, deeper ketosis, autophagy, autophagy peak) and when your plan is complete. They arrive even when the app is closed, and come back after a restart.
- Home screen widget. A battery-style ring showing how far into your fast you are, a live countdown, your current stage, and when the next stage starts.
- Wallpaper. Set any photo behind the app, with visibility, blur and fit controls, and frosted cards.
- Bouncier, livelier UI. Tabs slide and spring in, the tab bar has a sliding highlight, and buttons, checkmarks and numbers react when you tap them.

Install: download BC-Tracker.apk on your phone and open it. Needs Android 7.0 or newer. If you installed an older B.C Tracker app, uninstall it first.
